note: new trait: eye_diameter_mm (same key as main). Row and column mapping as returned by the page reader from the EJT PDF text (separate reads agreed on the ED values and row cells). Baniya, Alain Dubois, Morris Flecks, Daniel Jablonski, Joachim Schmidt, Christophe Dufresnes'; European Journal of Taxonomy 989: 189–214 (2025); DOI 10.5852/ejt.2025.989.2893 (also on the publisher article page). Headings printed above the account: Class Amphibia, Linne, 1758; Order Anura Fischer von Waldheim, 1813; Family Megophryidae Bonaparte, 1850; Genus Scutiger Theobald, 1868. Taxon., 989: 203', holotype ZFMK 104174; the page prints no explicit 'valid'; its URL path places it under Amphibia/Anura/Megophryidae/Leptobrachiinae/Scutiger.
